note.question: How do competitive markets shape pollution regulation?
note.overview: The paper develops a model of oligopolistic firms that produce partially differentiated products and generate pollution as a byproduct. The paper analyzes and compare two types of pollution regulation: Cap-and-Trade and Taxes. Firms can respond to regulation by any combination of pollution abatement, output reduction, emissions trading (under Cap-and-Trade), or payment of pollution taxes (under Taxes).
